tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250gsang thig skor gsum las/ yang dag phyag rgya gcig pa'i tshogs mchod bde chen bcud thig ces bya ba bzhugs so// 1$0000300mkha' 'gro sgyu ma bde ba'i mchog /dpal ldan bla ma yang dag par// grub pa gcig pu la phyag 'tshal// tshul 'di 'bri la byin rlabs stsol//

dus dang rgyun du 'di la 'jug bde'i tshogs mchod bya bar spro na/ dpal gtor sman raka phyi mchod tshogs kyi yo byad rnams bshams la/ skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa/ gter gzhung gi bdag bskyed bzlas pa ci 'grub mthar/ gtor ma byin rlabs dang gtor 'bul/ a kā ro lan gsum/ hūm̐: dpal chen 'khor dang sogs skong chog tshig rkang drug po lan gsum bdun sogs gang nus dang dbang len bya/ de nas tshogs chang snod thod pa yod na legs shing/ thod pa ma 'dzom na'ang chang snod mdun du bzhag /lag gnyis btegs la/ rang nyid he ru kar gsal ba'i: lag g.yas nyi mar ru lu bsgom: g.yon par zla bar ru lu bsgom: g.yas par bdud rtsi g.yon lha tshogs: g.yas pa'i bdud rtsi g.yon la 'bul: rjes chags bde sbyor 'od du zhu: thod pa'i chang dang dbyer med 'dres: zhes gsal btab la/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: lan gsum brjod cing lag g.yas mtheb srin sbyar bas g.yon la 'thor/ pad kor dang sor mo bsnol ba'i thal sbyar chang snod la dgab/ thod pa nyi zla'i snod yangs par: tshogs chang ru lu 'bru brgyad bsgom: 'od 'phros snod bcud bdud rtsi bsdus: sngags la thim nas 'od du zhu: ye shes bdud rtsi chen por gyur: ru lu lan gsum brjod/ bsang chu dang byin brlabs byas pa'i bdud rtsi des tshogs rdzas thams cad bran la/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsregs gtor bkrus: rnam par rtog pa dmigs med dbyings: ma las nyi ma'i snod yangs par: hūm̐ oṃ swā āṃḥhā rnams las: ye shes lnga yi 'dod yon sprin: bla na med pa'i tshogs su gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang: dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas: dpal chen khrag 'thung spyan 'dren gyis: dur khrod mchog gi gnas 'di ru: zhing chen gsar rnying ri ltar spungs: dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ rgya mtshor bskyil: ma lus bzhes shing bsnam du gsol:

oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ e h+ye hi ā na ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: dang po mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi tshogs mchod 'di: thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pañca kā ma gu ṇa pra tīts+tsha ho: bar pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: tshe rabs thog ma med pa tshun chad nas: da lta'i lus 'di blangs pa yan chad du: lus kyis sdig byas spyod pa ngan du spyad: ngag gis tshig rtsub 'khyal smra ngan du brjod: sems kyis blo nor log par bsam pa dang: 'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs bgyis pa: bkram pa'i lha tshogs rnams la bzod par gsol: ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang: de yi 'khor du gtogs pa'i lha srin rnams: mi yi skyon mthong tsam nas bar chad brtsam: nongs shing 'gal 'khrul ci mchis mthol lo bshags: zhes dang yig brgya brjod/ tha ma bsgral bstab ni/ nṛ tri badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ e yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: 'bar ba gtum chen rngams pa rnams: khros pa'i yid kyis bskul byas na: sangs rgyas bsod nams sku yang 'jig: bdud rtsi lnga dang zas lnga la: mtshan ma ming dang bcas pa la: bkug ste rdo rje phur pas bsgral: rdul du brlags nas tshogs su 'bul: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: sarba duṣ+ṭān mā ra ya hūm̐: zhes bsgral la/ hūm̐: rdo rje 'bar ba'i tshogs mchod 'di: mchod sprin kun tu rgyas gyur cig: dug gsum brtsegs pa'i ri bo 'di: sku gsung thugs kyi klong du stob: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti khā raṃ khā hi: zhes bstab bo// gal te tshogs 'bum phrag sogs gsog dgos pa'i skabs su 'di yan tshar gcig song nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin brlab/ ru lu 'bru brgyad mthar/ ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: hūm̐: dpal chen 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: sogs skong ba tshig rkang drug po brjod pa tshar re bya ba la grangs gzung ngo*// de nas brda dang brda'i 'bul len gyis tshogs drangs la/

rang nyid he ru ka dpal gsal: mgrin par rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs: snying gar yi dam zhi khro'i lha: lte bar gau rī mkha' 'gro rnams: gsang bar dam can chos skyong tshogs: tshogs kyi 'khor lor longs spyod pas: lus lha bde ba chen por mnyes: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol ba dang: bar chad sel zhing phrin las sgrub: bde chen ye shes rtsal rgyas shing: nyams rtogs gong nas gong 'phel zhing: he ru ka pa'i go 'phang shog: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: zhes brjod la nang gi tshogs su rol/ lhag ma dam tshig gi bdud rtsis bran la/ pañca a mṛta hūm̐ ha ho hrī: hūm̐: mkha' 'gro ging dang dbang phyug ma: ma bdun sring bzhi 'bar ma brgyad: pho nya la sogs lhag sdud tshogs: dpal gyi pham phab 'di gsol la: bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod: ces phyir dor zhing bshal chu bsngo la/ pha ma drin can 'gro drug dang: lan chags rnams kyis thob par bsngo: gnod sems sdug bsngal lan chags byang: thams cad bde chen thob par shog: ya hi gats+tsha: zhes brjod/ de nas tshogs mgron la dmigs te/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shab+da pañca kā ma gu ṇa pra tīts+tsha swā hā: sarba pañca a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: bdag med phyogs bral don dam thugs chud cing*// byams dang snying rjes dgra zin mi mnga' yang*// gdug pa 'dul phyir dus la mi 'da' ba'i// 'jigs byed he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces mchod bstod bya/ yig brgya brjod/ ma rnyed yongs su sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ hūm̐: sems can don phyir nan tan mchog bskyed de: ye shes thugs rjes bdag la dgongs nas kyang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub dam pa rnams: bdag la stsol zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: zhes dngos grub blangs la tshogs mgron rten yod na de dang med na rang la thim par mos/ snang srid 'od zhu sogs gter gzhung ltar bdag bskyed 'jug ldang bya/

dge bsngo shis brjod ni/ ho: bla med ye shes las byung ba'i: bsod nams mtha' yas dam pa des: mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa: he ru ka dpal thob par shog: 'gyur ba med pa rang gi gshis: rtag cing brtan pa rdo rje'i gnas: rang rig ye shes dbyer med par: mngon 'tshang rgya ba'i bkra shis shog: ces pas grub bo// spros par dgyes la mi mkho yang// blo dman rnams la phan pa yi// lhan thabs 'di sbyar dge mchis na// 'gro kun he ru ka thob shog /ces pa'ang nye bar gnas pa karma nor 'phel nas don du gnyer ba'i ngor/ 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pa rtsal gyis dpal chen ye shes kyi 'khor lor sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// //
